subject: City Charter Revision Articles 3, 5, 6, and 7
overview: The Governance Committee reviewed several articles of the proposed city charter, approving amendments to mayoral appointment provisions and election administration before referring the articles to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Paper 24-468: Resolution to Discuss Updates to the City Charter
items.summary: The Committee discussed Articles 3, 5, 6, and 7 of the draft charter, voting to amend mayoral appointment rules to account for local ordinances and to replace references to the City Clerk with the Board of Election Commissioners, before referring the articles to the Committee of the Whole.
